description: A stock type's override over what tools/ir2rwat.py derives (the reference; editor/src/ir/recipe/merge.ts the port): input.category - the IR category; input.derived - the IR name, the derived type, the model's doors, IR's passenger area, the model declaration with every door animation and door sound, the model's light groups; input.floor - what the floor generator gives for the override's floor options (null: none); input.inline - the recipe's own overrides.<id>; input.override - the per-type file. expected: the type and model declarations written, the type's lang entries, the converter's warnings about the override. Places in the OBJ frame, as the pack writes them.

cases.note: no per-type file: the derived type with the generated floor and the model's doors; every door's animation and sound stays
a freight car without floor: no interior, so no doors in the type, and no door animation or door sound in the model
a number set, one removed by null, an object merged key by key
_ keys are comments at any depth: in the file, in type, in brakes, in a doors object, in name; none reaches the pack
doors as an object: an edit by id in any case, a flag removed by null, a door the model hasn't added at the end
a derived door removed by null takes its animation and its sound with it; a null for no door is a warning

warnings: car: "doors" removes ghost, which isn't a derived door

cases.note: a list replaces the derived doors: a door the list drops loses its animation
an empty list turns the doors off
doors: null removes the key before the doors are worked out: the derived doors stay
an edit may give a door another id: the animation of the old id goes
the file's own interior wins over the generated floor
interior: null removes the key before the floor is put in: the generated floor stays
floor false: no generator, IR's passenger area is the floor
floor options the generator refuses: IR's passenger area is the floor
a freight car whose file has floor: the generator runs and its floor comes with the doors
the generator runs but gives no floor, and the freight car has no IR area: no interior
name and lights go to the lang files; en_us replaces the IR name; a group the model hasn't is a warning

warnings: car: "lights" names XX, which isn't a light group of the model (FBL, IL)

cases.note: sway goes to the model, after the derived keys
a sway out of 0..3 is left out with a warning

warnings: car: "sway" must be a number from 0 to 3, left out

cases.note: the model's own sway is merged last and wins
model fields merged: a livery added, the handbrake removed, one sound removed, one door sound changed
the recipe's inline override under the per-type file: objects merge, a null of the file wins and removes
type, model, name, lights, floor and sway null are as if not given
a locomotive: its cab seats from the file, a floor turned on, the derived traction partly replaced
